title: Sermon Library
description: The single contract between the pipeline (writer) and the app (reader). Book-by-book sermon series from a curated set of churches. App screens it serves: search/browse by book, church or speaker -> list of series for a book -> one series' sermons in preached order (title, passage, preacher, recording date). Rules JSON Schema can't express (enforced by pipeline/src/sermon_pipeline/validate.py): at least 80% of a series' sermons have a passage in the series' book (the rest are kept, in order, with their own book or no passage); each passage.book matches its display; consecutive sermons are at most 1 year apart; a series spans at most 3 years; sermons are in date order; all ids resolve.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema. Major bump = breaking change for the app.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the pipeline run that produced this file.

churches.description: Search/browse by church: filter series on series.churchId.

speakers.description: Search/browse by speaker: filter series on series.speakerIds. Speakers are global (not tied to one church) because preachers move and guest-preach.

series.description: Search/browse by book: filter on series.book. Display names and canonical order come from schema/books.json.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Never changes once published (app stores it for favourites / progress).

bookCode.description: OSIS book code; must match schema/books.json (checked by pipeline tests).

passage.description: Contiguous range within one book. Usually series.book; an interlude sermon (e.g. a Psalm in a Mark series) has its own book. Omit verses for whole-chapter ranges.

display.description: Human-readable reference as printed by the source, e.g. "Romans 1:1–17". Shown separately from the sermon title, which often isn't the passage.

series.description: One church preaching through (part of) ONE book. A church may have several series on the same book (e.g. Romans in 1985 and 2012); each is its own entry.

title.description: Series name as the church gave it.

speakerIds.description: Everyone who preached in the series: most sermons first, ties by first appearance. One or many.

sourceUrl.description: The church's page for this series, else its media page (attribution + 'open on website').

endDate.description: Date of the last sermon; at most 3 years after startDate.

isComplete.description: False while the church may still be preaching through it (last sermon within 28 days of generatedAt).

sermons.description: In preached order (by date, then the church's own media id). Includes the occasional off-book or reference-less sermon in the middle of a run; check passage.book against series.book to mark them.

title.description: As the church titled it; not necessarily the passage.

passage.description: The reference the source printed, preferring one in series.book. Omitted when the source printed none (never guessed).

media.description: At least one playable source. We link to the church's hosting; we never rehost.
